message.reasoning:
We need to answer question: "All the timestamps across our dashboard appear to be offset by several hours from our actual local time, and I'd like to know whether that's a per-user setting or a workspace-wide one I need to change."

We have policy excerpts about timestamps: stored UTC, displayed converted to timezone. Two settings: workspace default in Settings → General, and each person's own account timezone in personal Settings → Profile. Setting personal timezone overrides workspace default for that account only, without changing what anyone else sees.

Thus answer: It's per-user setting; each user can set personal timezone. If you want to change for all, change workspace default. Provide guidance.

We should not mention policy. Just answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! The timestamps are shown in the timezone that each user has set. If you want everyone to see the same time, adjust the workspace default in Settings → General. If you just want your own view to match your local time, change your personal timezone in Settings → Profile. That will override the workspace default for you only."}
